name: Beth-eked
line: Beth-eked of the Shepherds was a place on Jehu's road to Samaria, where he met relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah, who were killed at its well.

moments.title: Jehu meets Ahaziah's relatives
moments.text: On his way to Samaria, Jehu met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah at Beth-eked of the Shepherds. They said they had come to greet the sons of the king and of the queen mother.

moments.title: Forty-two men killed at the well
moments.text: Jehu ordered his men to take the relatives alive. They killed all forty-two men at the well of Beth-eked, and none were spared.
